rows.ARS: White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
rows.Bloom: White, cream center. Creamy white. Very double, cluster-flowered, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 30" (up to 75cm).
